back_translation: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down before me.
And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and placed the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces. Should I let Myself be inquired of by them at all?

Therefore speak to them and say, the Lord GOD says this: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and places the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him Myself according to his many idols,
that I may take hold of the hearts of the house of Israel, who have all become estranged from Me because of their idols.’
Therefore say to the house of Israel, the Lord GOD says this: ‘Repent and turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your abominations.

For when any Israelite, or any foreigner dwelling in Israel, separates himself from Me, sets up idols in his heart, and places the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Me, I the LORD will answer him Myself.
I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a byword, and I will cut him off from among My people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
As for the prophet, if he is enticed to speak a word, it was I the LORD who let that prophet be enticed; I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
Both will bear their punishment; the punishment of the inquirer will be the same as the punishment of the prophet,
so that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me, and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God, declares the Lord GOD.’”
The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,
“Son of man, when a land sins against Me by acting unfaithfully, and I stretch out My hand against it, cut off its supply of food, send famine upon it, and cut off from it both man and beast,
even if these three men—Noah, Daniel, and Job—were in it, they could deliver only their own lives by their righteousness, declares the Lord GOD.
If I send wild beasts through the land to leave it without people and desolate, so that no one passes through it for fear of the beasts,
even if these three men were in it, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they could not deliver even their own sons or daughters; they alone would be delivered, and the land would be desolate.
Or if I bring a sword against that land and say, ‘Let a sword pass through the land,’ and cut off from it both man and beast,
even if these three men were in it, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they could not deliver sons or daughters; they alone would be delivered.
Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath upon it with bloodshed, to cut off both man and beast,
even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, they could not deliver a son or a daughter; they could deliver only their own lives by their righteousness.
For the Lord GOD says this: ‘How much worse will it be when I send My four dire judgments—sword, famine, wild beasts, and plague—against Jerusalem, to cut off from it both man and beast!

Yet behold, there will be survivors left in it, sons and daughters who will be brought out; they will come out to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be comforted regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem—all that I have brought upon it.
They will comfort you when you see their conduct and their actions, and you will know that I have not done all this in it without cause, declares the Lord GOD.’”
